newsitem.title: CANADA: IBM Canada to sell unit to Onex.
newsitem.headline: IBM Canada to sell unit to Onex.

text.p: IBM Canada and Onex Corp said on Tuesday they signed an initial deal in which IBM Canada will sell its Celestica Inc unit to Onex for about C$750 million.

Celestica was established as a wholly owned unit of IBM Canada in January 1994. The company, which employs about 1,000 workers, produces memory products, power systems and also provides contract manufacturing services for Canadian and international customers.
IBM Canada, a unit of IBM Corp, said Celestica had reached a stage where independent ownership was the next logical step.
The companies said final agreements were expected in the next 60 days.
"Celestica is an outstanding corporation and will be Onex's largest acquisition," Gerald Schwartz, Onex president and chief executive, said in a statement.
He said Celestica would continue to be based at its facilities in Toronto.
